description:
Totals without paging rows: count, sum, average (ave), min or max of a field over the entries list_entries would list, optionally grouped by a field (a date by day, week or month) and broken down by a second field. Use it for 'how many / how much / total / average / top N / per month' questions instead of adding up list_entries pages.

The query parameters (module, listing, state, search, filters) ARE list_entries' — same names, same meaning, same access — so pass exactly what you would pass list_entries to read those entries.

The answer: `groups` [{key, count, value}] (with a breakdown, `values` [{key, value}] per group), `total` {count, value} over EVERY matching entry, `complete` (false: the module's engine read only its first 501 entries, so the figures are partial — narrow the filters, or say they are partial) and `groupsTruncated` (only the largest `top` groups, or the latest periods, are listed; `total` is still whole).

Filter or group by state when Cancelled or Draft entries must not count. What a figure means — signs, which entries belong in it — comes from the module's description and get_module_schema.

field.description: Field the metric reads (a number for sum/ave; a number or date for min/max). Not needed for count.

groupBy.description: Field to group by: a display name, or state, date, createdBy, assignees …

interval.description: Only when groupBy is a date field. Default day.

listing.description: Listing (saved view) name to query, case-insensitive; 'archive' targets archived entries. Defaults to the unfiltered 'Everything' view, which is admin-only on modules with listings — non-admins must name an accessible listing (an access-denied response lists them).

search.description: Free-text search across document ID, state, and text-like fields; supports * and ? wildcards

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Omit if set via env or set_workspace; required in stateless/remote mode.
